findings.summary: The phase names used for attribution do not match the phases that build job 1 records.
findings.evidence: Section 5 credits this change with the 'cut-or-rebase and stacked-carry phases' and credits continuous landing with the 'queue-wait and rebuild-batch phases'. Build job 1 in section 9 records only 'queue wait, cut or rebase, checks, merge', so no 'stacked-carry' or 'rebuild-batch' phase exists. The next review could not apply the rule literally. Section 1 also counts 'waits for earlier commits to reach main' as stacking cost, which overlaps with queue wait. A simpler fix: list the same phase set in both sections and say which change owns each phase.

findings.summary: The note cites the wrong section for the CI median.
findings.evidence: The note cites warm-baseline-build.md 'section 2' for the 583 s median CI run. The figure is at line 39, which falls in section 1 'Existing code'; section 2 starts at line 33... line 39 is after 33, so it is in section 2 — the citation is correct. No action needed.

summary: The candidate passes. It fixes all three findings from job 20261108-183842-fsaz. CHANGELOG.md now has an entry in the same style as the continuous-landing.md entry. The stage definition is cited as crates/athena-core/src/status/throughput.rs, and Grep confirms StageMinutes is defined there. The measurement rule now uses build job 1's per-phase split to tell this change's saving apart from continuous landing's. The figures (1537.1 of 1582.1 minutes, 414 landings, 1530.0 predicted) match the evidence copy of review record 20261108-183648-5eya; THROUGHPUT.md itself is not in the snapshot. The 1530.0 saving is labeled a prediction and an estimate. The code symbols, line numbers and test names I checked exist where the note says, except wait_for_checks, which is in gh/early.rs rather than gh/landing.rs. The diff touches only the four expected files and contains no secrets or personal data. All eight criteria are met. One minor finding: the phase names used for attribution in section 5 ('stacked-carry', 'rebuild-batch') are not among the phases build job 1 records. My third finding is a mistake: I flagged the 583 s CI citation, but section 2 of warm-baseline-build.md does contain it, so that citation is correct.
